title: Off-Cycle Internship, Venture Capital, 2027
description: This three-month off-cycle internship gives you the opportunity to work alongside experienced colleagues on meaningful, venture capital activity, shaping the internet and software sectors across the UK, Europe and global markets. You will contribute through financial analysis, company valuations, and market research. Activities include preparing investment memos and presentation materials, due diligence on prospective portfolio companies, financial modelling and valuation work for active and potential investments, and sector-specific research to identify emerging trends and investment opportunities. You are in your final year of university (bachelor's or master's), or have graduated within the last year with an excellent academic record. A basic understanding of valuation, accounting, and financial modelling. A strong interest in venture capital. Previous internship experience in venture capital, private equity, M&A, or deal advisory. Clear and confident communication skills with fluency in English; additional European languages would be an advantage.

title: 2027 Off-cycle Internship Program - EMEA
location: London, United Kingdom (also Frankfurt, Munich, Paris, Zurich)
description: Six-month Off-Cycle Internships across EMEA. The programme offers opportunities to work closely with and add value to a specific team, set and complete objectives, and be exposed to BlackRock's culture. Interns will develop new skills and gain valuable experience within the asset management industry. Private Debt positions are available in Paris and Munich. Candidates must be in their penultimate year of studies who will graduate with an undergraduate or master's degree between July 2027 and 2028. Applicants may apply to only one programme and up to two functions within that programme. Candidates have five days to submit a pre-interview assessment or face automatic withdrawal. Deadlines: Paris and Zurich 30 September 2026; Frankfurt and Munich 13 November 2026.

title: Winter 2027 Off-Cycle Internship Programme
description: Interns will work collaboratively in a high-performing team to create financial and economic analysis for senior executives and boards. Specific duties include performing financial modelling, historical financial analysis, and valuation assessments, preparing confidential information memoranda, management presentations, marketing pitches, conducting industry research, and coordinating due diligence activities. Candidates should hold a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, or a related field with an outstanding academic track-record. Prior internship experience in M&A, Private Equity or related roles is preferred. Required competencies include strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, exceptional interpersonal skills and strong communication, and fluency in written and verbal English. Status: applications closed 10 August 2026.
